problem_text:
A manufacturing firm must allocate its production of a specialized component across four distinct assembly lines, ensuring that the total distribution expense is minimized.

The component inventory available at each fabrication facility (set F) is as follows:
*Facility F1 has 69 units in stock.
*Facility F2 has 88 units.
*Facility F3 holds 189 units.
*Facility F4 maintains 59 units.

The requisite number of components for each assembly line (set L) is detailed below:
*Line L1 requires 181 units.
*Line L2 requires 46 units.
*Line L3 requires 39 units.
*Line L4 requires 95 units.

The per-unit handling and transit cost from each fabrication facility to each assembly line is provided in the accompanying matrix:

| From / To | L1 | L2 | L3 | L4 |
|-----------|----|----|----|----|
| F1        | 2  | 12 | 7  | 8  |
| F2        | 4  | 12 | 18 | 14 |
| F3        | 20 | 5  | 8  | 6  |
| F4        | 6  | 14 | 1  | 6  |

Determine the optimal shipment quantities to achieve the lowest possible aggregate expenditure.
